name: Three-Bean Chili
summary: Three canned beans, tomatoes, and corn in a spiced chili. Vegan and freezer-friendly.

ingredients.name: red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
white kidney beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 4–5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, all three cans of beans, and the corn. Add about half a cup of water.
Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot. Good with rice, bread, or a little grated cheese on top.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Check any pre-mixed chili seasoning for wheat-based fillers.

budgetNotes: Use whatever three canned beans are cheapest that week.
Freezes well — make a double batch and portion it.
A spoon of rice or a slice of bread turns it into a bigger meal.
